evals.prompt: 订单表要一个 64 位整数主键，多实例但不想上 Redis。帮我选 ID 算法并生成几个样例。
evals.expected_output: Agent picks uncoordinated entropy_id, runs python scripts/idgen.py generate entropy_id (and/or recommend), does not invent IDs by hand, notes same-second IDs are not strictly monotonic.
assertions: Recommends entropy_id / TimeBasedEntropyId, not mist_id as the default
Executes scripts/idgen.py (recommend and/or generate) rather than fabricating IDs
Does not require Java Maven or IdUtil as the only integration path
Does not default to uuid_v4 as the integer PK

evals.prompt: We need a time-sortable string primary key for Postgres. Generate 5 examples.
evals.expected_output: Agent selects uuid_v7, runs scripts/idgen.py generate uuid_v7 -n 5, explains index locality vs uuid_v4.
assertions: Chooses uuid_v7
Runs the Python generate script with count 5 (or equivalent --json)
Mentions uuid_v4 as a worse default for clustered indexes or equivalent

evals.prompt: Cluster must share one monotonic 64-bit allocator (we have Redis). Which algorithm?
evals.expected_output: Agent names mist_id, explains production needs a shared increment, may run generate with a local-only warning.
assertions: Names mist_id
States a shared counter/Redis/DB increment is required in production
Does not present the Python local counter as a cluster-safe allocator without warning

evals.prompt: The ID will be parsed with JavaScript Number in the browser. Don't break integers.
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends js_safety_id or stringifying 64-bit IDs; may run generate js_safety_id.
assertions: Recommends js_safety_id and/or serializing IDs as strings
Warns that 64-bit entropy/snowflake is unsafe in JS Number

evals.prompt: Just generate 5 UUIDv7 values; Go project, don't add Java.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs scripts/idgen.py generate uuid_v7 -n 5 and does not clone the Java GitHub repo or add Maven.
assertions: Executes the skill Python generate script
Does not clone https://github.com/ixiongdi/id-generator as the primary approach
Does not add Java/Maven dependencies

evals.prompt: Need a deterministic UUID from the order SKU 'orders:42' (name-based, SHA-1). Generate one; TypeScript app.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs scripts/idgen.py generate uuid_v5 --name orders:42 (not uuid_v3), does not hand-compute MD5/SHA-1, does not omit --name.
assertions: Uses uuid_v5 (or documents uuid_v3 as discouraged MD5)
Passes --name (or equivalent) to scripts/idgen.py generate
Does not invent the UUID in chat without running the script

evals.prompt: We want atomic_id as the cluster sequence. Generate five samples in Python.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains atomic_id has no local Python generator, production needs a shared counter, and does not print fake IDs as if generate succeeded.
assertions: States atomic_id is not implemented in scripts/idgen.py generate
Says production needs a shared counter (Redis/DB), not a process-local increment
Does not present fabricated atomic_id values as script output
